Reason (R): In Dahl's story, an aging elixir produces an instant transformation from youth to 75-year-old decrepitude; in Wright's poem, the boastful rescuer ends up trapped in the tree while the stranded cat lands on the ground triumphant.

explanation: Both texts turn conventional outcomes upside down to achieve brilliant slapstick and satirical humor.
